KONE MonoSpace 100 DX[1.0]
Save valuable space and gain greater design freedom with our machine-roomless elevator, built for residential buildings of every size.
AEM Assets - kone-monospace-100dx-hero
Reduce energy costs[2.0]
With a compact KONE EcoDisc hoisting motor, energy use is reduced and no separate machine room is required anywhere in the building.
FAQ[3.0]
What building types suit MonoSpace 100 DX?[3.1]
MonoSpace 100 DX suits residential buildings of low to medium height, with several configurations available for different traffic needs.
Is a machine room required?[3.2]
No, the KONE EcoDisc motor removes the need for a separate machine room, freeing up valuable space in the building.
